claims.claim_text: The indexed Captain Adrien Albarranc is very likely the French resistance member whose individual file is preserved under the Corvette network.
claims.evidence_paraphrase: French defence archives place an individual Adrien Albarranc file within the Corvette network series, and a Fondation Charles de Gaulle list independently records Adrien Albarranc with Corvette.
claims.identity_match_assessment: The exact uncommon name, wartime intelligence context, Captain rank in the OSS index, and two independent French archival or institutional references support a high-confidence identity. No private identifier was available for a direct match.
claims.temporal_assessment: The French sources establish wartime Corvette context but do not independently state the date of entry into OSS or prove a specific immediate pre-OSS employer.
claims.match_notes: This identity claim does not publish the discovery-only employer lead. Box 7 and the cited French individual files remain necessary for employment chronology.

person_updates.identity_evidence: The exact uncommon name and wartime intelligence context align across the NARA index, an official French defence finding aid placing an Adrien Albarranc individual file under Réseau Corvette, and a Fondation Charles de Gaulle list recording Adrien Albarranc with Corvette. No unique identifier match was available, so the identity is high confidence rather than confirmed.
person_updates.next_action: Review NARA Box 7 and French files GR 28 P 4 53/31 and GR 16 P 6010 for the sequence from civilian work and Corvette service into OSS. No reliable pre-OSS employer has yet been identified in the accessible final sources reviewed.

person_updates.identity_evidence: The visually verified index row supplies Dorothy O. Albaugh, Caf-3, and Box 7. A later obituary for a same-name woman and its paired Esten E. Albaugh reference are plausible leads, but neither source establishes OSS service, Box 7 linkage, or pre-OSS chronology.
person_updates.next_action: Review Box 7 for Dorothy O. Albaugh's full identity, Caf-3 duties, occupation or employer, and chronology; test the Dorothy Owen Albaugh lead only against direct file identifiers. No reliable pre-OSS employer has yet been identified in the accessible sources reviewed.
